titleEn: Commercial Renovation Costs in Vancouver 2026: What Businesses Actually Pay for Tenant Improvements
titleZh: 温哥华商业装修费用2026：企业实际支付的店铺装修成本
contentEn:
Commercial renovation costs in Vancouver in 2026 range from $50 to over $200 per square foot depending on the scope of work. A basic retail tenant improvement — new paint, flooring, and display fixtures — typically costs $50–$90/sq ft. A mid-range office fit-out with partitioned rooms, HVAC adjustments, and updated electrical runs $90–$150/sq ft. A full custom commercial space build-out, including structural changes, commercial kitchen equipment, or medical-grade finishes, can exceed $200/sq ft. Reno Stars has completed commercial projects across Metro Vancouver including a skin lab in Vancouver, a toy store in Metrotown Burnaby, and a dental clinic in Burnaby.

Planning a commercial renovation in Greater Vancouver? Contact Reno Stars for a detailed quote.

What Drives Commercial Renovation Costs in Vancouver in 2026?

Three factors determine what a Vancouver or Metro Vancouver business pays for a commercial renovation. First is the scope category: a retail or hospitality build-out costs less per square foot than a medical, dental, or food-service space that requires code-specific finishes and equipment. Second is the condition of the existing space — a gut renovation of a raw shell costs more than finishing a second-generation commercial space where plumbing and electrical are already in place. Third is permit complexity; projects in City of Vancouver, City of Burnaby, or City of Richmond that involve structural changes, changes of occupancy, or fire-safety upgrades require a commercial building permit that adds $3,000–$15,000 to the project cost and 4–8 weeks to the permit timeline.

Reno Stars price-marks commercial tenant improvements by square footage and scope category. The estimates below reflect 2026 Vancouver and Metro Vancouver market rates gathered from actual completed Reno Stars commercial projects.

The table below reflects what Reno Stars has actually charged on completed Vancouver and Burnaby commercial projects in 2025–2026. All figures are material and labour; they exclude furniture, equipment, and permit fees.

The cost for a 1,500 sq ft retail tenant improvement in Vancouver — a typical size for a neighbourhood shop or café — ranges from $75,000 to $135,000 for the base fit-out. A 3,000 sq ft mid-range office in Burnaby costs $270,000 to $450,000. A 2,000 sq ft dental clinic in Metro Vancouver costs $260,000 to $440,000 including medical-grade finishes and code-compliant mechanical work.

Planning a commercial renovation in Greater Vancouver? Contact Reno Stars for a detailed quote.

Do You Need a Building Permit for a Commercial Renovation in Vancouver?

Most commercial tenant improvements in Vancouver, Burnaby, Richmond, and Coquitlam require a commercial building permit. The threshold is a combined construction value over $5,000 — which covers virtually every professional fit-out. You also need a permit when the scope includes any change of occupancy classification, work on structural elements, modifications to fire-suppression systems, or any work in a building that is classified as a heritage property.

In the City of Vancouver, a change-of-occupancy permit requires a detailed floor plan, a code analysis showing the proposed use meets BC Building Code Division C requirements, and often a signage permit. The City of Vancouver's development permit and building permit process for commercial tenant improvements typically takes 6–10 weeks for approval. In Burnaby, the process is similar but the timeline is generally 4–8 weeks. Reno Stars handles the full permit application process, coordinates with the City of Vancouver or City of Burnaby building department, and manages inspections through to occupancy clearance.

Strata-titled commercial buildings in Vancouver and Richmond require strata council approval before any work begins. Reno Stars has experience navigating strata approval processes in Metro Vancouver commercial buildings and can submit the required documentation on the business owner's behalf.

How Long Does a Commercial Renovation Take in Vancouver?

A typical retail or café tenant improvement in Vancouver takes 4–8 weeks from permit issuance to handover. An office fit-out in Burnaby or Richmond takes 6–12 weeks. A restaurant or medical clinic in Metro Vancouver typically requires 10–20 weeks because of the additional mechanical, plumbing, and code compliance work. These timelines assume a standard change-of-occupancy permit has already been secured; projects requiring a heritage alteration permit or a complex change of use in the City of Vancouver can add 4–8 additional weeks.

On large commercial projects, Reno Stars typically breaks the work into phases — first fix, second fix, and final completion — so the business can begin partial operations while remaining construction zones are completed. A retail client can sometimes open the sales floor while the back-of-house kitchen is still being finished.

Frequently Asked Questions About Commercial Renovations in Vancouver

What is the average cost per square foot for a commercial renovation in Vancouver in 2026?

Vancouver and Metro Vancouver commercial tenant improvements in 2026 range from $50 to over $200 per square foot depending on the use type. Basic retail fit-outs run $50–$90/sq ft; mid-range office fit-outs $90–$150/sq ft; medical and dental clinics $130–$220/sq ft. The cost reflects the complexity of mechanical and plumbing work, not just finishes.

Does Reno Stars do commercial renovations in Burnaby, Richmond, and Surrey?

Yes. Reno Stars completes commercial tenant improvement projects across Metro Vancouver including Vancouver, Burnaby, Richmond, Surrey, and Coquitlam. Completed commercial projects include a skin lab in Vancouver, a toy store in Metrotown Burnaby, a dental clinic in Burnaby, and a commercial warehouse door renovation in Burnaby.

Can I do a commercial renovation in an occupied building without closing the business?

In many cases, yes. Reno Stars phases commercial renovations so that active areas of the business remain operational. A retail store can keep the front-of-house open while the back-of-house is being renovated, or a medical clinic can operate from one wing while the other is being completed. The key constraint is that construction noise and dust must be contained away from customer-facing areas, which Reno Stars manages with hoarding and negative air pressure controls.

What permits does a Vancouver restaurant renovation require?

A Vancouver restaurant renovation requires a commercial building permit from the City of Vancouver, a health inspection clearance from Vancouver Coastal Health before opening, and often a liquor licence amendment if the renovation changes the licensed area. The restaurant's change of occupancy classification must be registered with the City of Vancouver building department. Reno Stars coordinates the building permit and works with Vancouver Coastal Health as part of the project management scope.

Is a commercial renovation a tax deductible capital expense in Canada?

In Canada, qualified commercial leasehold improvements can be depreciated under the Capital Cost Allowance (CCA) system. Class 1, Class 3, or Class 8 CCA rates apply depending on the nature of the improvement and whether it is a building or equipment. A Vancouver accountant or tax professional can confirm the applicable class for your specific project. The GST/HST paid on commercial renovation services is generally recoverable as an input tax credit for GST-registered businesses.

2026年温哥华商业装修费用根据工程范围从每平方英尺50加元到超过200加元不等。基本零售店铺装修——新油漆、地板和展示架——通常每平方英尺50至90加元。中档办公室装修，配有隔断房间、HVAC调整和电路改造，每平方英尺90至150加元。全面定制商业空间建造，包括结构改造、商业厨房设备或医疗级装修，可超过每平方英尺200加元。聚星装修已完成大温地区商业项目，包括温哥华的皮肤工作室、本拿比Metrotown的玩具店和本拿比的牙科诊所。

2026年温哥华商业装修费用的驱动因素

三个因素决定温哥华或大温地区企业支付商业装修费用的多少。首先是工程类别——零售或酒店装修每平方英尺成本低于需要规范特定装修和设备的医疗、牙科或餐饮空间。其次是现有空间的条件——毛坯状态的全拆装修比已经有管道和电气的第二代商业空间装修成本更高。第三是许可证复杂度；在温哥华市、本拿比市或列治文市，涉及结构改造、 occupancy 变更或消防安全升级的项目需要商业建筑许可证，需额外支付3,000至15,000加元，许可证时间线延长4至8周。

按项目类型的商业装修费用明细

下表反映了聚星装修在2025-2026年完成的温哥华和本拿比商业项目的实际收费。所有价格均为材料和人工费；不含家具、设备和许可证费用。

零售店铺装修50–90加元 / 平方英尺油漆、地板、照明、展示架、标识粗装4–8周
餐厅/咖啡厅装修90–180加元 / 平方英尺商业厨房粗装、排气、油脂分离器、餐区装修8–16周

仓库/工业30–70加元 / 平方英尺钢架系统、装卸码头工程、环氧地板、夹层4–12周

这些是全包材料和人工成本。温哥华1,500平方英尺基本零售店铺装修费用—— neighbourhood shop 或咖啡厅的典型面积——基础装修费用从75,000到135,000加元不等。本拿比3,000平方英尺中档办公室装修费用从270,000到450,000加元不等。大温地区2,000平方英尺牙科诊所装修费用，包括医疗级装修和规范合规机械工程，从260,000到440,000加元不等。

温哥华商业装修需要建筑许可证吗？

温哥华、本拿比、列治文和高贵林的大多数商业店铺装修都需要商业建筑许可证。门槛是工程总价值超过5,000加元——这几乎涵盖所有专业装修。当工程范围包括任何 occupancy 分类变更、结构元素工程、消防系统改造或遗产物业工程时，您也需要许可证。

在温哥华市，变更 occupancy 许可证需要详细的平面图、显示拟议用途符合BC建筑法规C部分规范的分析，通常还需要标牌许可证。温哥华市商业店铺装修的开发许可证和建筑许可证流程通常需要6至10周批准。本拿比的流程类似，但时间线通常为4至8周。聚星装修处理完整的许可证申请流程，与温哥华市或本拿比市建筑部门协调，并管理直至 occupancy 验收的检查。

温哥华商业装修需要多长时间？

温哥华典型的零售或咖啡厅店铺装修从获得许可证到交接需要4至8周。本拿比或列治文的办公室装修需要6至12周。由于额外的机械、管道和规范合规工作，大温地区的餐厅或医疗诊所通常需要10至20周。这些时间线假设已经获得了标准变更 occupancy 许可证；需要遗产改造许可证或温哥华市复杂变更用途的项目可能需要额外4至8周。

关于温哥华商业装修的常见问题

2026年温哥华商业装修每平方英尺的平均成本是多少？

2026年温哥华和大温地区商业店铺装修费用根据使用类型从每平方英尺50加元到超过200加元不等。基本零售装修每平方英尺50至90加元；中档办公室装修每平方英尺90至150加元；医疗和牙科诊所每平方英尺130至220加元。成本反映的是机械和管道工程的复杂度，而不仅仅是装修。

聚星装修在本拿比、列治文和素里做商业装修吗？

是的。聚星装修在大温地区完成商业店铺装修项目，包括温哥华、本拿比、列治文、素里和高贵林。已完成的商业项目包括温哥华的皮肤工作室、本拿比Metrotown的玩具店、本拿比的牙科诊所和本拿比的商业仓库门改造工程。

可以在营业中的建筑进行商业装修而不关闭业务吗？

在许多情况下，可以的。聚星装修将商业装修分阶段进行，以便企业的活跃区域保持运营。零售店可以在后厨装修时保持店面营业，或者医疗诊所可以在一期工程完成时从一侧运营，而另一侧正在装修。关键约束是施工噪音和灰尘必须远离面向客户的区域，聚星装修通过隔离和负压控制来管理。
